claims.source_quote_ar: (وَإِنْ وَجَدْنَا) : مُخَفَّفَةٌ مِنَ الثَّقِيلَةِ، وَاسْمُهَا مَحْذوفٌ؛ أَيْ: وَإِنَّا وَجَدْنَا.
claims.claim_ar: اسمُ «إِنْ» محذوف في الصيغة المخففة؛ فالمخففة من الثقيلة واسمها محذوف.
claims.claim_en: The particle 'إِنْ' in its 'mukhafafa' (light/contracted) form is considered derived from the 'heavy' إنّ, and its ism (the noun that would normally follow) is omitted (i.e., an elided noun is implied).
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted passage discusses the phrase «وَإِنْ وَجَدْنَا» specifically; the source states a general syntactic rule about 'إِنْ' being مخففة and having اسم محذوف. Applicability to the instance in S2:278 (إِنْ كُنْتُمْ) is plausible but not explicitly analyzed in the provided chunk and should be verified against a direct commentary on this verse.

claims.claim_ar: قالَ الكوفيّونَ: إنْ من الثقيلةِ وتُفهم بمعنى «ما».
claims.claim_en: According to the Kufan grammarians, this 'إِنْ' belongs to the 'heavy' (الثَّقِيلَة) class and is to be understood with the sense of 'مَا'.
